steps.why: The first launch creates /sdcard/languages/ with one folder per language.

steps.text: Open MGSVR from Library > Unknown Sources. Accept the permissions it asks for, then pick your language. The first start prepares the discs, so keep some free space.

notes: One set of two discs per language; the user supplies at least one: every language is optional and in the group "language" (the payload marks English required). The guide has the user accept permissions on the first run; grantAll is a guess that -g covers them. Releases are all pre-releases; MGSVR-Pico.apk is avoided. The payload targetPath is only the English folder.
